operating_notes.text: Paisabazaar received CIT(A) orders confirming disallowance under Section 37 of ₹85.60 Cr for FY23 and ₹60.31 Cr for FY22.
Subsidiary PB Marketing and Consulting Private Limited granted SEBI registration as a Stock Broker for the Debt Segment on NSE.
PB Partners has 450,000 advisors covering 99% of PIN codes; 83% of premium now comes from small agents versus ~50% a year ago.
UAE business grew 54% YoY for the year and was 10-12% up for the quarter despite March disruptions.
PB Health has one operating hospital in Noida with ~₹150 Cr revenue and ₹20-30 Cr profit; a second hospital in Central Gurugram is to be operational by month end.
Contact centre accounts for almost 20% of revenue.
Health insurance combined operating ratio is 93%.
Policybazaar brings in about half of the industry's fresh young lives in health insurance.
